title: Machine Learning under Imperfect Data: Challenges and Methods
abstract: arXiv:2609.13914v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine-learning models are commonly developed under an assumption that training and test data are sufficiently complete, balanced, labelled, and drawn from compatible distributions. In practice, one or more of these conditions is often violated. Measurements may be missing or corrupted, rare classes may be poorly represented, supervision may be weak, and the deployment environment may differ from the training environment. These imperfections are usually treated as separate technical problems, although they alter learning through a small number of shared mechanisms: loss of information, biased empirical risk, ambiguous supervision, and unstable representations. This short survey organises representative methods around these mechanisms. It reviews reconstruction and generation, rebalancing and representation calibration, learning with limited supervision, adaptation across domains and modalities, and reliability under distribution change.

translated_title: 不完美数据下的机器学习：挑战与方法
translated_abstract: 机器学习模型通常是在训练数据和测试数据足够完整、均衡、有标注且来自兼容分布的假设下开发的。但在实践中，这些条件中的一个或多个常常被违反：测量数据可能缺失或损坏，稀有类别可能代表性不足，监督信号可能较弱，部署环境也可能与训练环境不同。这些不完美之处通常被视为独立的技术问题，但它们实际上是通过少数几种共享机制来影响学习过程的：信息丢失、经验风险偏倚、监督模糊以及表示不稳定。本简短综述围绕这些共享机制组织了代表性方法，回顾了重建与生成、再平衡与表示校准、有限监督下的学习、跨领域与跨模态的适应，以及分布变化下的可靠性。
tldr: 这篇综述指出数据不完美（缺失、不均衡、弱监督、分布偏移）通过少数共享机制影响机器学习，并围绕这些机制系统梳理了代表性解决方法。
en_tdlr: This survey organizes representative machine learning methods around the few shared mechanisms through which imperfect data—such as missing values, class imbalance, weak supervision, and distribution shift—affect learning.
